title: Use ObjectID in Connections and Inspector docks
body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/123653
- Related https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/121936

Changed both Inspector and Connections dock, since the Connections one was based on the Inspector.


## Additional information

Also fixes potential crash.
